messages:
Alex: Heads up - vendor needs a 30d slice of SIEM logs for vuln triage. Are we ok exporting raw auth logs to their S3, or do we need a filtered/anonymized export? @Maria any RBAC/kms constraints here?
Maria: short answer: we can export but not raw PII fields. Need a scrub + tokenization step and a scoped service account. also legal hold exceptions.
Dave: for infra: prefer using our export proxy that strips fields and applies sampling. We can add a route to deliver to partner bucket with restricted role.
Kim: compliance: what exact fields are you planning to remove? we usually require at minimum ip, user-agent redaction for external exports unless legal tells otherwise. 180d retention is default, but partner ask of 30d is fine if contracted.
Alex: vendor asked for full auth success/fail, timestamp, userid, resource. can we hash userids instead of plain?
Maria: yes hash + salt per-export is fine. important: salt must be ephemeral and not stored long-term. key unwrapping policy: only export proxy can unwrap via kms-proxy; no human access.
Dave: infra note: we'll create a dedicated IAM role: export-proxy/partner-<vendor>. Minimal perms: write to partner bucket, get-encryption-key via kms:Encrypt only through the proxy. No s3:GetObject.
Maria: also add an approval workflow in ticket system. automated request must include business justification, ATO checklist link: https://redwood-internal/corp/policy/export-approvals
Alex: quick Q on kms rotation: if we use CMK with keypolicy that allows proxy to Encrypt/Decrypt, do we need a keywrap-per-export to support revocation?
Maria: recommended: use envelope keys. CMK wraps ephemeral data key used only for that export. Rotation fine. if partner asks to delete earlier exports, we can delete objects and rotate salt, but cannot guaranteed full erasure in downstream if they made copies. document in contract.
Dave: implementation snippet for the scrubber lambda (very small):
```
// pseudo-js scrub rule
const keep = ['timestamp','event','result','resource'];
function scrub(record){ return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(record).filter(([k])=>keep.includes(k)).map(([k,v])=>[k, k==='userid' ? hash(v) : v])); }
```
Kim: legal hold edge-case: if there's an ongoing incident we must preserve originals. add flag in approval flow to mark as "incident-preserve" which blocks export deletion.
Alex: got it. last: RBAC change process — will this require org-wide role updates? I prefer scoped role creation instead of broad role changes.
Maria: yep create scoped role + entitlement manifest. I'll file a PR with the role template and OPA policy snippet.
sec-bot: Automated check: export-proxy role template validated. No sensitive fields detected in scrub rules. (reacts :white_check_mark:)
Alex: thanks. I'll start the ticket and loop vendor. tagging this as action items: Dave to provision role, Maria to PR scrub rules & KMS policy, Kim to draft contract clause. :thumbsup:
